pr_title: Improve appearance of player-wide background after failing with low background dim
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/16066. Would have liked to scale the background, but this gets a bit convoluted due to having to undo the scale on leaving player.

issue_context.title: Fail Animation doesn't look right with low background dim
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/16046
Originally posted by **NotGumballer91** December 12, 2021 Video: https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64581009/145693208-4bf58c54-bbcb-4003-90c3-6996b02b400b.mp4 Unsure if this is intended or not but: _It should animate the entire background with it._ Could look nicer. or _Remove the black box._ Works both ways. Despite that, I'm sure it's not really important(?) since I don't think most players would use background dim lower than 80%.

review_comments: Slightly uneasy about the onus of undoing this effect being on the next screen which is going to be resumed, but as far as I can tell this doesn't break anything (and I've tested several combinations, typical and atypical), so...
I agree with this sentiment. It looks like an error and I had to run the branch to make sure it works. The restoration behaviour is extremely hidden.
